names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Αυγούστου, «Όσιος Ψόης», with the rank word left off. The page offers no gloss on the name, as it does for most others.

Name page 1858 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Псой Египетский, прп.»; the rank is stripped and the epithet the page prints is kept. The folder held only the Greek «Ψόης». The day line gives the genitive «Псоя Египетского». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 августа ст. ст. — «Прп. Псоя Египетского (IV).»

attestations.note: The day's fourth entry and the same menologion day as the folder's Greek row, which is its only other venerated one. «Прп.» is the `venerable` the folder's `types` already carry. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the line's «(IV)» is the fourth century and would be this folder's first date of any kind, and this wave has declined to write a first date off a bare Roman numeral on a line — the standing author question. The reading life4409 was not opened. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Ψόης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The whole of the page is a distich and one sentence: he reposed in peace at prayer. No year, no place, no hymn of any kind. The name begins with a digraph the name sweeps fold badly, `ps-`, so the corpus was grepped for the Latin stem as well as read off the sweep before he was called new; the folders it returns are Kapsokalyvia and the like and none of them is a Psoes.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
